blocks.content: Quiz: When does prefetchQuery actually fetch data?
Tap an option below to answer:
It always fetches regardless of what's in the cache
prefetchQuery checks the cache first. If the data is fresh it does nothing.
prefetchQuery checks the cache first. If the data is fresh it does nothing.
It fetches only if the data is missing or stale in the cache
Correct. prefetchQuery is smart — it only goes to the network when the cache doesn't have fresh data.
Correct. prefetchQuery is smart — it only goes to the network when the cache doesn't have fresh data.
It fetches and then deletes the data after 5 seconds
prefetchQuery stores data in the cache normally. It doesn't delete it.
prefetchQuery stores data in the cache normally. It doesn't delete it.
It only works on mouse click events
prefetchQuery works anywhere. Mouse enter is just the most common use case.
prefetchQuery works anywhere. Mouse enter is just the most common use case.
